owner: P3 (detector-rule decision delegated by the captain; no stand hardware needed)
question: An obstacle far ahead can extend the bed fit (ALGORITHM §6, EXPERIMENTS §2d): beyond ~90 m the real bed stops returning, the base of an object standing there fills a 5 m bed bin, the fit lengthens and the far curvature follows; on set F this confirms edge fixtures 30-65 m beyond the object. Documented remedy: a far bed bin counts only when its bed points span the bed's width.

preregistered.code: a0f701f (branch wf7/bed-bin off claude/nifty-pascal-lzgl78); the flag is added after this file is committed
preregistered.note: written before any candidate run; only the shipped defaults were run before it (set F straight once, and the bin statistics below, which instrument the shipped fit without changing it)

flag.track.floor_far_min_width: m; 0 = off (default, today's fit byte for byte). A bed bin whose centre lies at or beyond track.floor_far_from is dropped from the bed fit when the lateral extent (max - min of dy) of its low points (Z at most 0.2 m above the bin's 20th-percentile level) is below this width AND at least track.floor_far_min_standing points stand on them: 0.3-1.5 m above the level, within 0.2 m of the low points' lateral extent (the face of an object standing on its foot; an overhead structure 1.6+ m up is not counted). floor_far_min_standing 0 = every narrow far bin is dropped (the remedy exactly as documented).
flag.track.floor_far_from: m, bin centre from which the check applies

candidates_in_order_of_preference.note: the documented remedy as written: every far bin narrower than 1.1 m is dropped

preregistered.order_of_work: per candidate in the order above: set F straight alone (scripts/far_range_eval.py with the gate's round-3 parameters), then the six recordings and set O (regression_gate.py on a cache without new_data, --allow 'ride.*' --allow 'set_F_straight.*'), then the full gate with the ride only for the candidate(s) that pass the cheap checks; all with --jobs 1, native path, receive stamps
preregistered.ship_rule: Ship the FIRST candidate in the order above that meets every condition; if none does, ship nothing (flag stays 0) and record the numbers. Conditions: (1) python scripts/regression_gate.py --cache /data/cache --jobs 1 --baseline docs/evidence/results/regression_baseline_2026-09-25_ride_column.json --set <candidate> exits 0, no gated row worse; (2) the target improves: the set F straight false detections summed over the five kinds (the gate's rows; 35 in the baseline: person 7, box1.0 13, box0.5 0, trolley 12, cable 3) drop below 35 with no kind higher; (3) the safety conditions below; (4) the verified range is not shortened (below).
safety_conditions: doubleT_obstacle: labelled hits per label (person_crossing, object_on_rail, object_on_rail_from_frame_75) identical or higher, first alarm frame identical or earlier, false-alarm events not higher
set O (cloud_with_fake_obj): every inside object's STOP frames not lower and first STOP not at a shorter distance; outside objects' false STOP frames and background alarm frames / ids not higher
set F straight, every kind (person, box1.0, box0.5, trolley, cable): sequences detected not lower, median first confirmation not shorter, median held-from (sustained) distance not shorter
no new false alarm: on each of the five obstacle-free recordings and on the ride, alarm frames, alarm events and STOP episodes not higher
no real or synthetic obstacle loses its STOP: a safety fix wins over a false-alarm gain; if unsure, do not ship
verified_range_conditions: advisory frames not higher on any of the six recordings and on the ride

the median of the per-frame height-reference range max(floor_range[1] + floor_valid_margin, floor_verified) not shorter on any of the six recordings, set O and the ride (from the gate's per-frame JSONL against the shipped defaults run through the same code)

far_bin_statistics.real_bins: set F backgrounds (straight ride sections): 179 of the 306 accepted bins at 90-125 m are narrower than 1.1 m (mostly 4-10 low points near the axis, 0 standing), 147 of them the last bin of the fit; 39 of the 306 are narrow with >= 3 standing points (structures at 102-117 m in new_data_169). Six recordings (every frame): 2 475 accepted bins at 80-125 m, 1 209 narrower than 1.1 m, 510 of them with >= 2 and 355 with >= 3 standing points (station and pressure-gate structures). Hence the standing condition in candidates A and B: the width rule alone (C) would drop most real far bins
